title: Mark all, section or field OK sets only OK and never adds values
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  2. An open, editable inspection with sections, checkbox fields and an untouched per-axle field (seed a template with these). Have some positions already given verdicts and some still Not inspected.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the action is offered at three levels — the inspection, a section and a field — with the same treatment, the label naming the level ('Mark all OK', 'Mark section OK', 'Mark field OK'), and that there is no axle level.
2. Confirm it sets OK only (no bulk Monitor, no bulk Not OK) and sets verdicts only (a measured value is never invented).
3. Confirm it never overwrites a verdict already picked — only Not inspected positions change — so marking everything good then correcting the bad ones works in either order.
4. Press it on an untouched per-axle field and confirm it reaches and stamps the axles shown before anything is entered.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The action is offered at three levels — the inspection, a section and a field — with the same treatment. The label names the level: 'Mark all OK', 'Mark section OK' and 'Mark field OK'.
  • There is no axle level: an axle is part of a per-axle field, which 'Mark field OK' covers.
  • It sets OK only: there is no bulk Monitor and no bulk Not OK.
  • It sets verdicts only; a measured value is never invented.
  • It never overwrites a verdict already picked — only positions still Not inspected change — so marking everything good and then correcting the bad ones works in either order.
  • A press reaches an untouched per-axle field, stamping the axles it shows before anything is entered.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9883 (S18 — Mark a whole scope OK in one press); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S18; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S18-R1: “The action will be offered at three levels, the inspection, a section and a field, with the same treatment. The label names the level: 'Mark all OK', 'Mark section OK' and 'Mark field OK'. There is no axle level: an axle is part of a per-axle field, which 'Mark field OK' covers”
  • S18-R2: “It will set OK only. There is no bulk Monitor and no bulk Not OK: a bad finding stays a deliberate act”
  • S18-R3: “It will set verdicts only. A measured value is never invented”
  • S18-R4: “It will never overwrite a verdict already picked. Only positions still Not inspected change, so marking everything good and then correcting the two bad ones works in either order”
  • S18-R5: “A press will reach an untouched per-axle field. The axles it shows before anything is entered are the axles it stamps”

Amended on 5 October 2026
S18-R1 changed on 5 October 2026 (Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905 (read on 5 October 2026)): the label names the level, and there is no axle level. The S18-R1 quote above is the current wording, and step 1 and the expected results follow it.

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
